name: @openalpha/runtime
description: Self-hosted AI trading research analyst. Screens, scores, debates and sizes trade ideas across VN equities, gold and crypto - and never places an order you did not approve.

scripts.check: biome check && bun run typecheck && bun scripts/check-cycles.ts && bun scripts/check-dag.ts && bun scripts/check-imports.ts && bun scripts/check-sdk-exports.ts && bun scripts/check-conventions.ts && bun scripts/check-log-keys.ts && bun scripts/check-display-contract.ts && bun scripts/check-line-limits.ts && bun scripts/check-function-limits.ts && bun scripts/check-cli-contract.ts && bun scripts/check-migration-rollback.ts && bun scripts/check-table-registry.ts && bun scripts/check-unused-exports.ts && bun scripts/check-reachability.ts && bun scripts/check-version-pairs.ts && bun scripts/check-dep-licenses.ts
scripts.lint:arch: bun scripts/check-depth.ts && bun scripts/check-trading-gates.ts && bun scripts/check-registry-isolation.ts && bun scripts/check-trading-locale.ts && bun scripts/check-report-figures.ts && bun scripts/check-caveat-details.ts && bun scripts/check-error-messages.ts && bun scripts/check-vi-terminology.ts && bun scripts/check-reasoning-capability.ts && bun scripts/check-pricing.ts && bun scripts/check-agent-skills.ts && bun scripts/check-feature-isolation.ts --strict && bun scripts/check-strategy-version.ts && bun scripts/check-research-i18n.ts && bun scripts/check-research-integrity-regressions.ts && bun scripts/check-scene-layers.ts
scripts.typecheck: bun run gen && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json && tsc -p src/web/tsconfig.json
scripts.dev: bun run gen && bun run src/app/main.ts
scripts.build: bun run gen && bun build src/app/main.ts --compile --splitting --outfile dist/openalpha
scripts.build:all: bun run gen && bun build src/app/main.ts --compile --splitting --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile dist/openalpha-linux-x64 && bun build src/app/main.ts --compile --splitting --target=bun-linux-arm64 --outfile dist/openalpha-linux-arm64 && bun build src/app/main.ts --compile --splitting --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile dist/openalpha-darwin-arm64 && bun build src/app/main.ts --compile --splitting --target=bun-darwin-x64 --outfile dist/openalpha-darwin-x64 && bun build src/app/main.ts --compile --splitting --target=bun-windows-x64 --outfile dist/openalpha-windows-x64.exe && bun build src/app/main.ts --compile --splitting --target=bun-windows-arm64 --outfile dist/openalpha-windows-arm64.exe
